about: Tasks for the owner's Ox app. Only the repo owner and Claude sessions can change this file.

tasks.title: The boss in my poop-themed .io game resurrects and eats loot to heal, so players have to race it for pickups
tasks.first_comment:
Shiteven, a free multiplayer browser game I made: https://shiteven.fun
Five bosses with different kits; this one (Septic Lord) heals from pickups and comes back at half HP, so the fight is half dodging and half denying it loot.
